# adapters-fixture

Small demo app. This file duplicates the whole contract for every AI tool
instead of staying a minimal entry point.

## Rules

1. Build with `make build`.
2. Test with `make test`.
3. Lint with `make lint`.
4. Use conventional commits.
5. Keep functions under 20 lines.
6. Write tests for everything.
7. Never use global variables.
8. Prefer pure functions.
9. Document every export.
10. Ask before adding dependencies.
